description: This Java class defines the event 'FeatureDefinitionDeleted', which is emitted after a feature's definition has been deleted from a thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for constructing instances, deserializing from JSON, and accessing event details like feature ID and resource path.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionDeleted
classes.description: Represents an event indicating that a feature's definition was deleted from a specific thing, including properties like featureId, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and event handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance with explicit parameters including ThingId, featureId, revision, timestamp, headers, and metadata.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a FeatureDefinitionDeleted instance, using the provided headers.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the feature whose definition was deleted.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resource representing the feature's definition.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Appends event-specific payload data to the JSON object during serialization.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the event object, incorporating featureId and superclass hash.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object, considering featureId and superclass fields.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality check to verify class compatibility.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event, including class name, superclass info, and featureId.
